scope: First batch: three original unconjugated stability observations reused in Wilkerson2020; separate PEG and activity records for these same sites. Other Wilding variants assessed in availability matrix but not individually curated here.

construct_source.location: Methods 3.2 Plasmid Preparation: cysteine-free T4 Lyz in pY71, C-terminal Strep-tag

shared_expression.method: E. coli-derived CFPS; cysteine-free T4 Lyz in pY71 with C-terminal Strep-tag; 3 mM AzF for single variants; 30 °C overnight (~15 h in this work)

unconjugated.reaction: Unconjugated pAzF variant; no attached PEG. Controls mimic reaction incubation; no-PEG WT reference.

PEG5kDa.reaction: 5 µM purified T4 Lyz + 50 equivalents 5 kDa DBCO-mPEG in PBS; 37 °C, 280 rpm, 18 h

PEG20kDa.reaction: 5 µM purified T4 Lyz + 20 equivalents 20 kDa DBCO-mPEG in PBS; 37 °C, 280 rpm, 18 h

thermal_assay.method: Protein Thermal Shift Assay on unpurified reaction aliquots; derivative method; 25–99 °C ramp; matched control per PEG condition

activity_assay.method: EnzChek; reaction mixture diluted to final 0.06 µM lysozyme; 37 °C, 2 h endpoint, 494/518 nm; PEG-conjugate activity subsequently calculated using Eqs. 1–3
